rules.name: single_user_facing_product
rules.law: ForgeBoss is the normal user-facing engineering application; separate AI chats, Git/PowerShell/test-runner/coding-agent UIs are not required for the normal path.

rules.name: product_form
rules.law: Desktop is the primary workshop; mobile is a companion remote; web is the account/cloud dashboard; all surfaces consume one canonical project/run truth.

rules.name: canonical_authority
rules.law: ForgeBoss owns authoritative project state, workflow, permissions, evidence, decisions, spend and release state; external engines never become canonical authority.

rules.name: reuse_before_build
rules.law: Substantial work requires an upstream reuse review before custom implementation; build from scratch only with a recorded reason.

rules.name: worker_reviewer_separation
rules.law: A material builder cannot independently accept, approve or review its own work.

rules.name: chief_of_staff_observer_only
rules.law: Chief of Staff reconciles and reports authoritative state but has no mutation, approval, merge, deploy, spend or permission authority.

rules.name: worker_pack_contract
rules.law: Reusable workers are versioned descriptive packs; packs cannot grant themselves authority and upgrades preserve provenance and local modifications.

rules.name: self_improvement_subordinate
rules.law: Learned state may improve execution but cannot rewrite permanent rules, permissions, canonical evidence, acceptance state or approval requirements.

rules.name: proven_learning_only
rules.law: Only independently proven repair lessons may be replayed automatically, and only when authoritative preconditions still match.

rules.name: no_blind_paid_retries
rules.law: A failed paid/model attempt cannot be repeated without new evidence, corrected preconditions, narrower scope or a materially different recorded strategy.

rules.name: deterministic_first
rules.law: Use reliable deterministic/local/free validation before another paid model call when it can answer the question.

rules.name: durable_run_identity
rules.law: Every material task/run has durable identity and provenance covering project, role, worker, route, authority, inputs, snapshots, outputs and evidence lineage.

rules.name: silent_and_unexpected_work
rules.law: Expected work without evidence is SILENT; unscheduled or paused-but-running work is UNEXPECTED_RUN and must be surfaced.

rules.name: durable_resume
rules.law: Long-running work resumes or reconciles from authoritative persisted state after ordinary interruption; ambiguous recovery fails closed.

rules.name: exact_evidence_binding
rules.law: Evidence proves only the exact artifact/snapshot/run it names; older proof cannot automatically prove a newer candidate.

rules.name: release_prover
rules.law: Final proof is bound to the exact final artifact/evidence set and produces READY, NEEDS_REPAIR, BLOCKED or PROOF_INCOMPLETE.

rules.name: evidence_derived_status
rules.law: UI PASS/FIXED/READY/SECURE/COMPLETE states derive from canonical stored evidence, never model prose alone.

rules.name: replaceable_commodity_components
rules.law: Models, worker engines, gateways, workflow engines, sandboxes, browsers, memory engines and integrations remain replaceable behind ForgeBoss-owned interfaces where practical.

rules.name: no_capability_self_escalation
rules.law: Workers, packs, plugins, skills and dependencies cannot widen their own tools, write scope, spend or permissions.

rules.name: native_proof_distinction
rules.law: Portable/source-level proof is not native-platform/runtime proof; platform-specific claims require matching evidence.

rules.name: hostile_review
rules.law: Green tests are provisional; important changes require independent hostile review of alternate/bypass/historical paths.

rules.name: mutation_regression_proof
rules.law: Important protections should be weakened/removed in a controlled test where practical to prove their regression test actually fails.

rules.name: owner_interruption_policy
rules.law: Routine worker updates are consolidated into an owner/Chief-of-Staff brief where practical; urgent safety/authority failures may interrupt immediately.

rules.name: fail_closed
rules.law: Unknown or unverifiable authority, identity, evidence or safety state blocks the affected action rather than being guessed.

rules.name: secrets_boundary
rules.law: Secrets and credentials stay out of source control, prompts, ordinary logs and evidence exports unless an explicit secure mechanism owns them.

note: This file is a product contract. Runtime enforcement is tracked separately; models and workers must not treat this manifest itself as permission to mutate or execute.
